title.en: Imposing a code breaks the symmetry of forms
title.zh: 施加之码打破形式之对称

statement.en: For any family and any forms, imposing one code makes all agree in a step, keeps every exchange of formations and keeps no renaming that moves a form it gives: agreement from symmetry without a formation above the others.
statement.zh: 对任意族与任意形式，施加一码一步使众一致，保持形成之一切交换，而不保持移动其所给之形之改名：无一形成居上而自对称得一致。

laws.en: Imposing a code keeps every exchange of formations; where a renaming moves the form the code gives some sense, imposing does not keep that renaming.
laws.zh: 施加一码保持形成之一切交换；凡改名移动该码所给某义之形，施加不保持该改名。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; any type of formations, senses and forms.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；任意之形成、义与形之类型。

does_not_show.en: That a code is in fact imposed, or that imposing is better than another way to agree.
does_not_show.zh: 实际有码被施加，或施加优于其他致一致之方式。

correspondence.en: Symmetry breaking: a symmetric dynamics reaches an asymmetric state only through an asymmetric term.
correspondence.zh: 对称破缺：对称之动力只经不对称之项达不对称之态。
